register_artifact.description: Register a monitor artifact. Arguments, all required: sha256 (string, 64 hex), contractSha256 (string, 64 hex), reportId (string, 64 hex), verdict (one of pass, fail). Only verdict pass registers. Operator approval required.

properties.verdict: string, required, one of: pass, fail

diagnostic_load_model.description: Push a registered artifact. Arguments, required: deviceId (string), sha256 (string, 64 hex, must be registered). Operator approval required.

journal_rows.description: Journal rows. Arguments, optional: deviceId (string), since (number). Returns rows with duty_percent and current_amps.
